achievement.description: Unlocks or revokes an achievement. If no achievement is provided, all achievements are unlocked or revoked.

act.description: Jumps to an act. If integer, will jump to that act. Otherwise, replaces the current act with the act passed.

afflict.description: Apply the specified affliction to a card in the player's hand

ancient.description: Opens an ancient event with the selected choice

art.description: Lists all the content of the specified type that is missing art. {TypesHint}

block.description: Gives block to player, or to target creature if index is given (0 is player).

card.description: Spawns a card into a pile (hand by default). Screaming snake case ('BODY_SLAM', not 'Body Slam').

cloud.description: Deletes all save files from Steam Cloud, if you are running on Steam

damage.description: Damage all enemies, or target creature if index is given (0 is player).

dump.description: Dumps Model ID database to console & logs.

enchant.description: Enchants a card in the player's hand with the specified enchantment.

event.description: Jumps a player to a specific event.

fight.description: Jumps a player to a specific encounter.

getlogs.description: Gathers logs, automatically zips them to a file containing 'name', and opens the directory containing the zip file.

heal.description: Heal the player some amount of HP.

help.description: Lists every command, or one command's usage.

kill.description: Will kill one target if the index is given, or all if 'all', or the first if no arguments.

leaderboard.description: Adds scores to the leaderboard. Option can be upload|random. If random, <count> random scores will be uploaded to leaderboard <name>. If upload, one score will be uploaded to leaderboard <name> with <score>.

log.description: Set log level for specific log types. Type can be: {string.Join(",", Enum.GetNames<LogType>())}. Levels can be: {string.Join(",", Enum.GetNames<LogLevel>())}

multiplayer.description: Opens the multiplayer menu, or the test scene if test is the first argument

open.description: Opens a common path in the local OS file browser.

potion.description: Adds potion to belt. Screaming snake case ('ENTROPIC_BREW', not 'Entropic Brew').

power.description: Grant power to given target at index.

relic.description: Adds/Removes relic from player (add by default)

remove_card.description: Removes a card from your Hand or Deck. Screaming snake case ('BODY_SLAM', not 'Body Slam').

room.description: Jumps a player to a specific room.

sentry.description: Test Sentry error reporting. 'test' sends a test message and exception, 'message <text>' sends a custom message, 'exception' throws a test exception, 'crash confirm' triggers a native crash (terminates game!), 'status' shows Sentry status.

trailer.description: Toggles the ability to show and hide UI elements via 0 - 9 and +- keys.

travel.description: Enables you to jump to any room on the map.

unlock.description: Marks all cards/potions/relics/monsters/events/acts/epochs/ascensions as discovered, or 'all' to unlock everything.

upgrade.description: Upgrade the target card based on its hand position (0 is the left most).

source: extracted from the game files by scripts/console_catalog.py extract
